dog.description_text:
Meet North! She's ready to find her way home, and we hope her compass is pointing straight toward YOU! Rescued from a heartbreaking hoarding situation in Georgia, North deserves a future filled with love, comfort, and all the little joys that make life special. Now it's time for a new direction, one that leads to a family who will cherish her and never let her wonder where she belongs. Could North be the girl who leads you to your new best friend?

Every bio is just a snapshot of the animal. For more information about North and to learn if she may be the right fit for your home, please reach out to our Adoptions Team.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
